function.name: open_app
function.description: Open a Fredo desktop app/application by the name the user said. Use ONLY for an explicit open request.

function.name: close_app
function.description: Close an open Fredo desktop app/application by the name the user said. Use ONLY for an explicit close request.

function.name: doom_mode
function.description: Use ONLY when the user explicitly asks Fredo to enter or leave Doom Mode.

surfaces.description: Create or edit a wireframe in the Fredo Wireframe app. Call this whenever the user asks to create, draft, sketch, mock up or visualize an app/screen/page/dashboard — including "let's create a new wireframe for <app>" or "I would like a way to visualize <thing>": use action=wireframe.companion.draftApp with app_name set to the app the user named, then the page is drafted for you. Use ONLY for Wireframe requests.

commands.label: Text
commands.description: Add a text element (body or heading style)

commands.label: Icon
commands.description: Add an icon from the curated set

commands.label: Section
commands.description: Add a site frame section (header, nav bar, sidebar, footer)

commands.label: Lock
commands.description: Lock or unlock the selected element

commands.label: Fit page
commands.description: Fit the page to the screen

commands.label: Reset view
commands.description: Reset to 100% and centre the page

commands.label: Save As
commands.description: Save the document to a new file

commands.label: Export PNG
commands.description: Export the page as a PNG

commands.label: Lock group
commands.description: Lock or unlock the selected group

commands.label: Align left
commands.description: Align the selected elements to the left

commands.label: Align centre
commands.description: Align the selected elements to the centre

commands.label: Align right
commands.description: Align the selected elements to the right

commands.label: Distribute
commands.description: Distribute the selected elements with equal gaps

commands.label: Select
commands.description: Switch to Select mode so clicks and drags select and move elements

commands.label: Rectangle
commands.description: Arm the rectangle draw tool so the next drag creates a rectangle

commands.label: Ellipse
commands.description: Arm the ellipse draw tool so the next drag creates an ellipse

commands.label: Create shape
commands.description: Create a rectangle or ellipse at explicit page bounds, or arm the matching draw tool when only the shape is given

commands.label: Fill
commands.description: Set the fill token of the selected shape

args.name: fill
args.description: Fill token: surface, muted, border, text, textMuted, accent, success, warning, error or info

commands.label: Draft app
commands.description: Draft a deterministic starter wireframe for a named app: a navbar, a heading with the app name, and a report card

args.name: app_name
args.description: The app name the user named; used for the heading and the report card label

args.name: summary
args.description: Optional context; the deterministic draft does not use it

offer.name: wireframe
offer.description: Create or edit a wireframe in the Fredo Wireframe app. Call this whenever the user asks to create, draft, sketch, mock up or visualize an app/screen/page/dashboard — including "let's create a new wireframe for <app>" or "I would like a way to visualize <thing>": use action=wireframe.companion.draftApp with app_name set to the app the user named, then the page is drafted for you. Use ONLY for Wireframe requests.
